question: Kalamandalam Kalvanikutty Amma was honoured with Kalidasa Samman in 1997-1998. She was famous for which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kalamandalam Kalvanikutty Amma** was honoured with** Kalidasa Samman in 1997-1998 **for her contribution to** Mohiniyattam.**
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form of Kerala<
